year_policy: Year follows the linked primary source: first arXiv publication unless a conference proceedings page is used. Venue years are separate where verified.

papers.title: Agentless: Demystifying LLM-based Software Engineering Agents
papers.mechanism: Separate localization, repair and patch validation into a constrained flow instead of an unrestricted action loop.
papers.reported_findings: The authors report competitive SWE-bench Lite repair performance at low inference cost, and identify misleading or underspecified benchmark issues.
papers.project_relevance: Motivates a small inspectable pipeline. Quant Lab has deterministic calculation and validation stages; it does not reproduce the paper agent.
limitations: Repository repair benchmarks differ from financial calculations.
No controlled Agentless ablation was run in this project.
papers.decision: Retain simple stage boundaries; add autonomy only after a measured benefit.
papers.verification_scope: Primary metadata and abstract verified; no claim of reproducing the paper results.

papers.title: Code Generation with AlphaCodium: From Prompt Engineering to Flow Engineering
papers.mechanism: Use structured problem analysis and repeated code execution against tests in a multi-stage generation flow.
papers.reported_findings: The authors report higher CodeContests pass@5 than a direct prompt in the tested GPT-4 configuration.
papers.project_relevance: Supports explicit specifications, tests and inspectable failures. The local research engine uses maintained calculations rather than generating candidate code.
limitations: Paper pass@5 is not the competition single-solve metric.
Generated tests can share mistakes with generated code.
papers.decision: Use independent numerical and accounting checks; defer multi-candidate inference.
papers.verification_scope: Primary metadata and abstract verified; no claim of reproducing the paper results.

papers.title: CRITIC: Large Language Models Can Self-Correct with Tool-Interactive Critiquing
papers.mechanism: Evaluate an initial answer with external tools, then revise it using the resulting evidence.
papers.reported_findings: The authors report improvements in question answering, mathematical program synthesis and toxicity reduction, emphasizing the role of external feedback.
papers.project_relevance: Provides context for bounded diagnostics and independent verification. Historical TypeError trials test local diagnostic behavior, not CRITIC itself.
limitations: Tool feedback is only useful within its validity scope.
No causal CRITIC comparison or real-model Quant Lab run exists.
papers.decision: Ground explanations in actual check outcomes; keep hidden grading material out of solver feedback.
papers.verification_scope: Primary metadata and abstract verified; no claim of reproducing the paper results.

papers.title: Debug like a Human: A Large Language Model Debugger via Verifying Runtime Execution Step by Step
papers.mechanism: Inspect intermediate variables at basic-block boundaries and assess execution against the task specification.
papers.reported_findings: The authors report improved debugging across HumanEval, MBPP and TransCoder using execution-level information.
papers.project_relevance: Suggests semantic checkpoints such as discount factors and cash balances. Existing bounded exception diagnostics are narrower than an LDB tracer.
limitations: The recorded trials did not retain full runtime state and do not establish LDB effectiveness.
Tracing untrusted generated code requires verified isolation.
papers.decision: Defer general tracing; expose maintained-engine intermediate quantities when they explain a failed invariant.
papers.verification_scope: Primary metadata and abstract verified; no claim of reproducing the paper results.

papers.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
papers.mechanism: Interleave reasoning with actions and observations so plans can change in response to the environment.
papers.reported_findings: The authors report benefits on knowledge-intensive question answering and interactive decision tasks compared with reasoning-only or acting-only approaches.
papers.project_relevance: An earlier competition release used a bounded ReAct variant. Quant Lab v0.1 intentionally has no autonomous tool loop.
limitations: The historical submission result is not a controlled paper reproduction.
Its aggregate score does not identify which mechanism helped or failed.
papers.decision: Keep the historical outcome; require a fixed-budget comparison before adding a model-driven loop.
papers.historical_adaptation: Bounded competition variant; not an exact reproduction.
papers.verification_scope: Primary metadata and abstract verified; no claim of reproducing the paper results.

papers.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
papers.mechanism: Store textual reflections on task feedback in episodic memory to guide subsequent trials without updating model weights.
papers.reported_findings: The authors report gains across decision-making, coding and reasoning tasks and analyze feedback and memory choices.
papers.project_relevance: Suggests retaining verified lessons and failures. This archive is curated evidence, not an implemented Reflexion learning policy.
limitations: Repeated trials and reflective text can amplify incorrect lessons.
No project experiment isolates reflective memory.
papers.decision: Store evidence provenance and uncertainty; do not turn an unverified explanation into a universal rule.
papers.metadata_note: Authors follow the linked arXiv v4 metadata.
papers.verification_scope: Primary metadata and abstract verified; no claim of reproducing the paper results.

papers.title: RepoCoder: Repository-Level Code Completion Through Iterative Retrieval and Generation
papers.mechanism: Alternate similarity-based repository retrieval with code generation to improve the context used for completion.
papers.reported_findings: The authors report improvements over in-file and ordinary retrieval baselines on line, API and function completion tasks in RepoEval.
papers.project_relevance: Supports locating relevant contracts and utilities instead of loading every historical archive into a prompt.
limitations: An indexed evidence archive is not a trained code-completion system.
No retrieval ablation is available for Agenthon or Quant Lab.
papers.decision: Keep references small and searchable; defer iterative generation-driven retrieval.
papers.verification_scope: Primary metadata and abstract verified; no claim of reproducing the paper results.

papers.title: RepoGraph: Enhancing AI Software Engineering with Repository-level Code Graph
papers.mechanism: Provide repository-level structural navigation through a code graph that can augment existing software-engineering agents.
papers.reported_findings: The authors report gains when adding the module to several SWE-bench approaches and examine another repository-level completion benchmark.
papers.project_relevance: May help a larger library locate dependent conventions and callers. The present package is small enough for explicit file references.
limitations: Index maintenance adds complexity.
No graph was built or evaluated for this release.
papers.decision: Defer until repository size produces a measured localization problem.
papers.verification_scope: Primary metadata and abstract verified; no claim of reproducing the paper results.

papers.title: Repoformer: Selective Retrieval for Repository-Level Code Completion
papers.mechanism: Train a code model to decide when retrieval is useful and to handle noisy retrieved context.
papers.reported_findings: The authors report improved repository-level completion and substantial serving speedups from avoiding unnecessary retrieval in their evaluated settings.
papers.project_relevance: Motivates selective reference loading in the research skill. A hand-selected index does not implement the paper trained retrieval policy.
limitations: Paper latency results depend on its serving setup.
No local speedup or learned-policy effectiveness is claimed.
papers.decision: Read only references relevant to the request; defer training a retrieval policy.
papers.verification_scope: Primary metadata and abstract verified; no claim of reproducing the paper results.

papers.title: CodeT: Code Generation with Generated Tests
papers.mechanism: Generate tests and candidate programs, then rank solutions using execution agreement between programs and tests.
papers.reported_findings: The authors report better solution selection across several code-generation benchmarks and model sizes.
papers.project_relevance: Explains why generated tests may help explore disagreements, but financial assertions still need independently justified assumptions.
limitations: Agreement among generated artifacts is not an independent correctness proof.
No generated-test candidate selection is implemented or evaluated here.
papers.decision: Retain independent numerical checks; defer best-of selection and additional inference.
papers.verification_scope: Primary metadata and abstract verified; no claim of reproducing the paper results.

papers.title: FITS: Modeling Time Series with 10k Parameters
papers.mechanism: Model time series with complex-frequency interpolation and a compact learned parameterization.
papers.reported_findings: The authors report competitive forecasting and anomaly-detection performance with a small model after reducing selected high-frequency components.
papers.project_relevance: Inspires lightweight spectral diagnostics, not a claim that market noise should be discarded or that FFT predicts profitable trades.
limitations: The trained FITS model differs from a deterministic FFT summary.
No local forecasting, trading or Agenthon ablation was run.
papers.decision: Do not train or promote a spectral model without a chronological controlled comparison.
papers.verification_scope: Primary metadata and abstract verified; no claim of reproducing the paper results.

papers.title: Frequency Adaptive Normalization For Non-stationary Time Series Forecasting
papers.mechanism: Separate changing spectral components and predict their evolution alongside a normalized residual forecasting model.
papers.reported_findings: The authors report MSE improvements when applying FAN to four forecasting backbones on eight benchmark datasets.
papers.project_relevance: Suggests explicitly examining trend and seasonality assumptions before adding spectral evidence to a financial workflow.
limitations: Forecasting error on those datasets does not establish financial predictability or trading returns.
No FAN training or local model comparison was performed.
papers.decision: Keep spectral preprocessing experimental; compare against ordinary statistics before adopting it.
papers.verification_scope: Primary metadata and abstract verified; no claim of reproducing the paper results.
